subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

NOTICE
Please help keep our park clean. Do not leave rubbish on the grass. Put all plastic bottles into the ______ bins near the gate.
explanation: 'Recycling bins' là thùng tái chế, đúng nghĩa khi chai nhựa cần được thu gom. Ba đáp án còn lại không phù hợp về nghĩa.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word or phrase that best fits the gap.

NOTICE TO STUDENTS
The computer room will be ______ for maintenance from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. this Friday, so please save your work before then.
explanation: Cấu trúc bị động 'will be + past participle' cần quá khứ phân từ: 'closed' (bị đóng cửa).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the health tip and choose the word that best fits the gap.

HEALTH TIP
Doctors advise adults to ______ at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise every week to stay healthy.
explanation: Cấu trúc 'advise sb to do sth' (khuyên ai làm gì) cần động từ nguyên thể sau 'to': 'get'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the announcement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

ANNOUNCEMENT
Students who wish to ______ the summer English course must register at the office before 30 June.
explanation: 'Attend a course' nghĩa là tham dự một khoá học. Các động từ còn lại không đi với 'course' theo nghĩa phù hợp.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the sign and choose the word that best fits the gap.

SIGN AT THE TEMPLE
Visitors are kindly requested to ______ the temple's traditions by removing their shoes before entering the main hall.
explanation: 'Respect the traditions' nghĩa là tôn trọng truyền thống, phù hợp với việc cởi giày trước khi vào chánh điện.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

IT SECURITY REMINDER
Please ______ your password regularly and never share it with anyone to protect your online account.
explanation: 'Change your password' nghĩa là đổi mật khẩu định kỳ để bảo vệ tài khoản. Các từ còn lại không phù hợp về nghĩa.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the news item and choose the word that best fits the gap.

LOCAL NEWS
The local council is planning to ______ more trees along the river to reduce air pollution and make the city cooler.
explanation: 'Plant trees' nghĩa là trồng cây, phù hợp với mục tiêu giảm ô nhiễm và làm mát thành phố. 'Cut' trái nghĩa với mục tiêu này.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the poster and choose the phrase that best fits the gap.

HEALTH CENTER POSTER
Many people find it hard to ______ smoking, but our support groups can help them to stop completely.
explanation: 'Give up smoking' nghĩa là bỏ hút thuốc. 'Take up' là bắt đầu, 'put on' là tăng cân hoặc mặc vào, 'look after' là chăm sóc.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical conversation.

a. Oh, that's a good idea. I'll turn off my phone at 10 p.m. from now on.
b. Hi Mai, you look tired. Did you sleep well last night?
c. Not really. I was scrolling through my phone until almost midnight.
d. Well, try putting it away an hour before bed. It really helps.
explanation: Thứ tự logic: b (hỏi thăm giấc ngủ) → c (trả lời: lướt điện thoại đến nửa đêm) → d (gợi ý cất điện thoại trước khi ngủ) → a (đồng ý và cam kết).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical letter.

a. Finally, I hope you can visit me during the winter holidays.
b. Dear Lan, I hope you are doing well.
c. I have just started at a new school in Da Nang, and I really enjoy it.
d. My classmates are friendly, and our teachers are very helpful.
explanation: Lá thư mở đầu bằng lời chào (b), kể về trường mới (c), nói về bạn bè và thầy cô (d), rồi kết bằng lời mời (a).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical paragraph.

a. During these weeks, families clean their houses and buy new clothes to welcome the new year.
b. Tết, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year, is the most important festival of the year.
c. Just before the holiday, many people travel back to their hometowns to reunite with their relatives.
d. On the first day, children receive lucky money in red envelopes from their grandparents.
e. Preparations begin weeks before the holiday, and shops become crowded with shoppers.
explanation: Đoạn văn giới thiệu Tết (b), chuẩn bị bắt đầu từ vài tuần trước (e), 'During these weeks' nối với (e) nên (a) dọn nhà đón năm mới theo sau, sát Tết thì về quê đoàn tụ (c), rồi đến ngày đầu năm nhận lì xì (d).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical paragraph.

a. Finally, the recycled materials are turned into new products such as bags and bottles.
b. Many schools now run recycling programs to cut down on waste.
c. First, students separate paper, plastic and metal from other rubbish.
d. Then, the sorted materials are collected and taken to a factory for processing.
explanation: Đoạn văn mở đầu bằng chương trình tái chế ở trường (b), học sinh phân loại rác (c), vật liệu được thu gom và xử lí (d), cuối cùng thành sản phẩm mới (a).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical paragraph.

a. However, teachers still need to check the answers, because the software sometimes makes mistakes.
b. Artificial intelligence is now widely used in education.
c. For example, some apps give students instant feedback on their English writing.
d. Its main advantage is that it can save teachers' time and let students learn at their own pace.
explanation: Đoạn mở đầu về việc AI được dùng rộng rãi (b), nêu ưu điểm chính (d), đưa ví dụ minh hoạ cho ưu điểm đó (c), rồi kết bằng hạn chế với 'However' (a).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a logical conversation.

a. Thanks, Doctor. I'll cut down on coffee and get more sleep.
b. Good morning, Doctor. I've had a headache and have felt tired for a week.
c. Hmm, it sounds like stress. Are you sleeping well?
d. Not really. I usually stay up until after midnight studying.
e. Then try going to bed earlier and drinking less caffeine. Come back in two weeks if you still feel unwell.
explanation: Bệnh nhân trình bày triệu chứng (b), bác sĩ hỏi về giấc ngủ (c), bệnh nhân trả lời (d), bác sĩ đưa lời khuyên (e), và bệnh nhân cảm ơn (a).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Climate change is affecting coastal cities around the world. Rising sea levels can flood streets and damage homes. ______ That is why many governments are building sea walls and planting mangrove forests to protect their communities.

options.text: Scientists have stopped studying the ocean because it is too dangerous.
Fishermen are the only people who are affected by the sea.
Flooding is becoming more frequent, and many residents must move to safer areas.
The weather in these cities has never changed over the past century.

explanation: Câu C nối tự nhiên với 'That is why': ngập lụt ngày càng thường xuyên nên chính phủ xây đê và trồng rừng ngập mặn. Các đáp án còn lại không phù hợp mạch đoạn văn.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Many people now use online maps to find their way. These apps show real-time traffic, so drivers can avoid congestion. ______ Users can therefore still find directions when they have no internet connection.

options.text: Traffic jams never happen in big cities anymore.
Many apps allow users to download maps in advance for offline use.
Drivers must always pay a monthly fee for these apps.
Phones have stopped using satellites to find locations.

explanation: Câu B là tiền đề cho 'Users can therefore still find directions...': nhờ tải bản đồ trước nên vẫn chỉ đường được khi không có mạng.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Students today have many ways to learn outside the classroom. Online courses allow them to study at any time, and video lessons can be replayed as often as needed. ______ Such flexibility helps them learn at their own pace.

options.text: Teachers have become less important than before.
Exams have been canceled in most schools.
Online courses are free for every student in the world.
Learners can pause a lesson and review its difficult parts whenever necessary.

explanation: Câu D mô tả việc tạm dừng và xem lại phần khó, tạo tiền đề cho 'Such flexibility' (sự linh hoạt này) giúp học theo tốc độ riêng.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the phrase that best fits the gap.

Water puppetry is a traditional art form that began in the Red River Delta more than 1,000 years ago. Puppeteers stand behind a screen and control wooden puppets ______, which makes the show unique and memorable.

options.text: on the surface of a pool of water
in a silent room without any music
in a dark room lit only by candles

explanation: Múa rối nước: các con rối được điều khiển trên mặt nước, đó là đặc trưng làm nên sự độc đáo của loại hình này.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Sleep is essential for good health. Adults who sleep fewer than six hours a night have a higher risk of heart disease and weight gain. ______ Experts recommend a regular bedtime and a dark, quiet bedroom to improve sleep quality.

options.text: Waking up early on weekends is the best way to rest.
Sleep needs are the same for teenagers and older adults.
Because of this, people should treat sleep as seriously as diet and exercise.
Caffeine has no effect on the body's ability to fall asleep.

explanation: 'Because of this' nối với hệ quả của thiếu ngủ (bệnh tim, tăng cân), dẫn đến khuyến nghị coi giấc ngủ quan trọng ngang chế độ ăn và tập luyện.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Many coral reefs around the world are dying because of rising ocean temperatures. Corals depend on tiny algae that live inside their tissues. When the water becomes too warm, the algae leave, and the corals turn white. ______

options.text: Scientists have discovered that corals can survive without any water.
If this bleaching continues, many reefs may disappear within several decades, and countless fish will lose their homes.
Corals are the largest animals ever found in the deep sea.
Warm water makes reefs more colorful and attracts more tourists.

explanation: Câu B nêu hệ quả của hiện tượng tẩy trắng san hô: rạn có thể biến mất và cá mất nơi cư trú. Các đáp án còn lại đi ngược nội dung đoạn văn.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Cities around the world are becoming hotter, and many urban residents are looking for ways to stay cool. One solution that is gaining popularity is the green roof, a rooftop covered with plants and a thin layer of soil. Green roofs can absorb rainwater, which reduces the risk of flooding in busy streets during the rainy season. They also provide a natural layer of insulation, so buildings need less air conditioning in summer. As a result, owners can save money on electricity bills.

Beyond these practical benefits, green roofs offer a home for birds, bees, and other small creatures that are losing their habitats in crowded cities. Some schools have built small gardens on their roofs, where students learn about plants and the environment. However, green roofs are not cheap to install. The structure of the building must be strong enough to hold the extra weight of soil and water, and regular maintenance is required to keep the plants healthy. For this reason, experts suggest that governments provide financial support to homeowners who want to build them.

Despite the costs, many researchers believe that green roofs will become more common in the future. As cities continue to grow, the demand for cooler and healthier living spaces will only increase.

What is a green roof, according to the passage?

options.text: A roof made of glass that lets sunlight pass through
A roof used only for parking cars
A rooftop covered with plants and a thin layer of soil
A roof that collects rainwater in large tanks

explanation: Đoạn 1 định nghĩa: green roof là mái nhà được phủ thực vật và một lớp đất mỏng.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Online learning has changed the way many students study. Thanks to video lectures and digital textbooks, learners can access high-quality lessons from anywhere with an internet connection. For students in remote mountain areas, this can be a real opportunity to learn from teachers in big cities. Many universities now offer online courses that students can complete at their own pace.

However, online learning also has its challenges. Without a teacher standing in front of the class, some students find it difficult to stay focused and motivated. Others lack a quiet place at home or a reliable internet connection, which makes it hard to join live lessons. Experts say that students who study online need strong self-discipline and good time-management skills. Without these, it is easy to fall behind.

To overcome these problems, many schools have adopted a blended approach, combining online lessons with face-to-face classes. This model allows teachers to spend more time helping students with difficult topics, while still giving learners the flexibility of studying at home. Some teachers also use short quizzes and discussion forums to check understanding and encourage participation.

Ultimately, technology is a tool rather than a replacement for teachers. The most successful learning environments are those in which teachers and technology work together.

According to the passage, what is one advantage of online learning?

options.text: Students are always required to attend live classes.
Learners can access lessons from anywhere with an internet connection.
Students no longer need to use computers or phones.
Teachers are no longer needed in any school.

explanation: Đoạn 1: nhờ bài giảng video và sách điện tử, người học có thể tiếp cận bài học chất lượng cao từ bất kỳ đâu có internet.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Coffee has been part of Vietnamese daily life for more than a century. In Hanoi, many people start their mornings sitting on tiny plastic stools at a street-side café, sipping strong black coffee and chatting with neighbors. For many older residents, this slow ritual is more than a habit; it is a way of staying connected with the community.

In recent years, however, a new generation of young people has transformed this tradition. Modern cafés in Ho Chi Minh City now offer creative drinks, such as coconut coffee and cold brew, and they attract customers with comfortable seats and free Wi-Fi. Many young professionals meet friends or work on their laptops there, which has changed the social role of coffee shops.

Health experts, meanwhile, have mixed opinions about coffee. Moderate consumption, around two or three cups a day, is linked to some health benefits, such as better concentration and a lower risk of certain diseases. Yet many popular drinks contain large amounts of sugar and cream, which can increase the risk of weight gain and heart problems. Doctors therefore advise drinkers to choose less sugary options and to avoid coffee late in the day, since caffeine can disturb sleep.
